description: Found in November 1978 at about 40 m depth in Kura Bay off Shirohama in Minamiuwa District and raised on 1979-07-14; believed to be one of the six aircraft that failed to return from the action of 1945-07-24; the only Shiden-Kai on display in Japan and the only significant aircraft exhibit in Shikoku; free admission
aliases: N1K2-J; N1K2J; Shiden-Kai; George; 紫電改21型
